column1: # June V.0.4 MappedID -> index -> Blowfish seed (unpacked_x2.exe). Static: hash_map 0x3376d550 filled by FUN_31c516d0
# (300 inserts of {char* @0x33448xxx, index}); parser FUN_31c4d350 rotates MappedID right by (Size & 7) before the lookup
# (key[i] = MappedID[(i - r) mod 8]). seed = sum mod 2^32 of the 5 dwords at 0x33445428 + index*20 (FUN_31c47a00 @31c47b3d),
# formatted "%u" (0x33438a58); Blowfish key = SHA-1 of that decimal string (20 B). Index 0 is unused (all-zero row).
